examples: Run git, a dev server or a quick script next to an agent without opening another session or touching the agent's terminal.
Switch to another agent with the panel open and get a shell in that agent's folder.
how_to: Open a session on a desktop-width window and press the terminal key on the bottom bar (the bar is shown when you move to its handle at the bottom edge).
Type as in any terminal: the shell starts in the folder the agent was started in, and it is listed under terminals in the sidebar, nowhere else.
Close the panel and open it again: the same shell comes back with its scrollback; it closes with its agent.
An agent on a paired computer shows a short note instead of a shell.
An agent or script reads the same shell and its pane through the MCP tool session_shell_get.
name: Terminal widget
summary: a plain shell per agent, opened from the bottom bar in the agent's folder, kept running in tmux, listed only under the drawer's terminals and closed with its agent.
where: The bottom bar under the terminal grid, its first key, at 1024 wide or more.
media_exempt: screenshots and captures are not part of the open source export
